adopt: Expose one local port to one remote caller and take it away again.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Everything an agent runs is behind NAT on somebody's laptop, and every workaround (a port forward, a public IP, a broker somebody maintains) becomes permanent.

Install
pip install awtunnel

Commands
  awtunnel

Quick start
  pip install awtunnel

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awtunnel/
synopsis: Reach a service that has no public address.
